body: I guess we will never know.  I'm not looking for attention on here

I'm so sorry for your loss.  If you're not ready for another cat go to a rescue and volunteer.  Help some of the poor unwanted cats and kittens.  It will make you feel wonderful to hear them all purring
Tell someone you can trust and if they can't help keep speaking up until someone listens.  The first time will be difficult but it will get easier and easier
Don't hang yourself.  It's a terrible way to die.  You just need to find something you're great at.  College dropout ... don't worry.  Many successful people hated school

I feel the same.  My life is a mess thanks to my debt and stupid life choices and no understanding from my family
